messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Canary rollout canary-v14 in us-west2 showing large p99 latency spike on streaming endpoints. p95: 350ms (baseline 120ms) -> p95 anomaly, p99: 6.3s (baseline 1.2s). streaming_stall_rate: 3.7% (baseline 0.2%). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internals/d/l426/canary-telemetry?orgId=1&from=now-15m. Rollout started by DeployBot at 3639875200. Paging SRE on-call.
Eli: @here I'm oncall, looking now. Can someone tag runtime + deploy?
Olivia: I'm pulling gateway traces and per-pod logs. See concentrated error/queueing on /v1/stream endpoints routed to v14.
Matt: Noted. This smells like KV-cache thrash we saw during encoder change in last test. Will check kv hit/miss.
Jana: v14 changed tokenization and default context to 4096 in canary config. Sequence length distribution may be much higher.
DeployBot: Rollout details: canary batches 5% -> 10% -> 25% every 10m. Current: 25% rolled at 3639876000. Background: deploy id dpl-2026-03-15-14.
Olivia: Traces show latency concentrated on streams. Per-instance metric: `kv_cache_evictions=1834` in last 5m on canary pool.
Olivia: ```
[stream-worker-7] WARN kv_cache: eviction key=encoder_0_1234 size=4096 time=2026-03-15T14:02:12Z
[stream-worker-7] WARN request=stream id=abcd1234 tail_latency_ms=6200
[stream-worker-2] WARN kv_cache: eviction key=encoder_1_9876 size=4096 time=2026-03-15T14:03:08Z
```
Matt: Quick check command: `rwdctl metrics query --cluster=us-west2 --metric=kv_evictions --since=10m --group-by=pod` - that should show thrash concentrated on stream-worker pods.
Jana: I just pulled token lengths from the canary traffic sample: seq_len p50=128 p90=1024 p99=2048. Baseline was p99~512. That increase would blow past KV capacity assumptions.
Olivia: Immediate mitigation options: A) Pause/abort the rollout and rollback to v13, B) Route canary traffic to v13 while leaving v14 paused, C) Increase cache size/scale up nodes (temporary). Fastest is B then A.
Eli: Do B. @DeployBot can you shift traffic and stop the rollout now?
DeployBot: Running: `rwd-route set --model=canary-v14 --traffic=0 --region=us-west2 && rwd-route set --model=stable-v13 --traffic=100 --region=us-west2`
DeployBot: Command accepted. Note: draining streams may take ~30-60s.
Matt: Also recommend we temporarily reduce streaming concurrency to avoid head-of-line stalls: `rwdctl config set runtime.max_inflight_streams=8 --region=us-west2` and `rwdctl config set runtime.batch_size=1 --region=us-west2`.
Olivia: Scaling option executed as fallback: `k8s scale nodegroup/canary-usw2-gpu --replicas=3` (spun up 1 extra GPU node) — should be ready in ~2m.
Rosa: Heads-up to CS: drafting short customer message. Will post to beta list: "We're seeing elevated streaming latency in us-west2 for canary model; rolling back to stable; investigating; no data loss." Will update if anything changes. :wave:
Jana: Root cause hypothesis: tokenization/config change increased sequence lengths causing cache thrash + more KV loads per request. Postmortem action: add sequence-length check gate to rollout pipeline and block if seq99 > 1024.
Eli: Setting monitoring alert: page if p99 > 2s for >2 consecutive 1m windows after the routing change completes.
IncidentBot: Incident channel created: #inc-3639876543. Incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/3639876543. Status: mitigation in progress.
Olivia: Rollout pause confirmed. Traffic is back to v13 in us-west2. Rolling metrics: p95=130ms, p99=1.1s, streaming_stall_rate=0.3% (rolling 5m). Still monitoring.
Rosa: Customer note sent to beta contacts. Three customers reported UI hitches but no errors. Will follow up for any session data.
Eli: I'll keep this ticket open and watch for 2h. Then handoff to Matt for deeper runtime tuning and kv resizing.
Matt: I'll take post-incident action items: KV sizing, guardrails for tokenizer/context changes, and investigate whether eviction policy or sharding needs change.
Jana: I'll add extra evals for longer-context workloads to the canary gating infra and tighten rollout gating.
Olivia: Closing the live mitigation loop: rollback succeeded, metrics back to normal. Creating follow-up postmortem and sched meeting for root cause + permanently mitigate. :white_check_mark:
Eli: Handoff note: next oncall @Matt will own follow-up. Incident resolved->monitoring.
